mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 59 degrees with clear skies by Harriet Park, and we have a first quarter moon visible tonight.

The city has launched a significant infrastructure effort including the Mark Drive reconstruction and general street rehabilitation projects. These updates include replacing water and sewer mains, repaving roads, and installing new sidewalks to improve pedestrian connectivity throughout the city.

Today is packed with activities like the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
In a noteworthy call for service, an officer arrested a 44-year-old woman for operating while intoxicated last Friday after she was discovered unresponsive behind the wheel.
The flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so be sure to head over then to grab your favorite treat.
